20261122-physics-e2-1.goal: Apply principles of Qilleensa hundaa baasanii alaa bakka duwwaa to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e2-1.material: [Yaada Qoqqoodamaa] Qilleensa hundaa baasanii alaa bakka duwwaa (vacuum) glaas keessatti sa'aatii dammaasaa kaa'anii alarmii hojjechiisan. Ittiin-bu'aa sa'aatii dhoqqee bilbilaa tuqus sagaleen gonkumaa dhaga'amuu dhabuu isaa sababni maali?

20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Yaada Qoqqoodamaa] Qilleensa hundaa baasanii alaa bakka duwwaa (vacuum) glaas keessatti sa'aatii dammaasaa kaa'anii alarmii hojjechiisan. Ittiin-bu'aa sa'aatii dhoqqee bilbilaa tuqus sagaleen gonkumaa dhaga'amuu dhabuu isaa sababni maali?
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.explain: Sagaleen raafama wanta akka qilleensaa (miidiyaamii) keessa deema, kanaaf bakka qilleensi hin jirre (vacuum) keessatti sagaleen hin darbu.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Sagaleen gurra keenyatti dhufuuf wanta fe'u akka qilleensaa barbaada.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Duwwaa keessa molekuulii gaasii homtuu hin jiru.

20261122-physics-e2-2.goal: Apply principles of Zaayiloofooniidhaan yeroo tuqxan, paaxxii gabaabaa fi to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e2-2.material: Zaayiloofooniidhaan yeroo tuqxan, paaxxii gabaabaa fi paaxxii dheeraa sagaleen irraa baasu ol-gadi fageenya wal-bira qabuun isa sirrii kami?
20261122-physics-e2-2.thinking.0: Zaayiloofooniidhaan yeroo tuqxan, paaxxii gabaabaa fi
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Zaayiloofooniidhaan yeroo tuqxan, paaxxii gabaabaa fi paaxxii dheeraa sagaleen irraa baasu ol-gadi fageenya wal-bira qabuun isa sirrii kami?
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Dheerinni paaxxii gabaabaa yoo ta'e, lakkoofsi raafamaa sekondii tokko keessatti (frequency) baay'ata, sagaleen ol-aanaan baha; dheerinni yoo dheeraa ta'e frequency xiqqaata sagaleen gad-aanaan baha.

20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Lakkoofsi raafamaa baay'ee yoo ta'e sagaleen ol-aanaa ta'a.
